_about: Pop-up scene layers per garment, in public/popcard/<id>/. back = backdrop 1200x900 (far layer); mid = one landmark that stands beside the doll on side `mid`; wings = two landmark halves standing either side of the doll (used instead of mid); prop = an object on the floor on side `prop`; fg = plant strip 1200x178 (nearest layer); full-nu / full-nam = the doll already dressed in this áo, 1200x1600, a ready picture for covers and thumbnails.
